remarks: Two-bedroom, two-bath condominium featuring an open floor plan with a living room and dining area open to the kitchen. The living room has sliding doors leading to a private balcony. The primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet and a full en-suite bath. The second bedroom also offers access to a private balcony. Additional features include an in-unit washer and dryer and a private storage area in the basement.  The unit is in need of new carpeting and interior paint and is being sold in its current condition. The complex offers an in-ground swimming pool with a pool house. Conveniently located near the Glenbrook Metro-North train station and within walking distance to downtown Stamford, restaurants, shopping, and other local amenities. Easy to show.
